description: On a writable copy of the idx fixture, Index.Name of TI's ixU is set to ixU2 (Name and DBEngine.Errors read), then Index.Name of ixDesc is set to ixMulti, an existing index name, and ixIgn's to ixPK (DBEngine.Errors). TI's Indexes (after Refresh) are listed with Name, Primary, Unique and Fields; after Close and reopen they are listed again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
